result.reason: The operative language reaches at least the fallback: affiliates are covered on terms more favorable than written notice, and assignment is permitted to an M&A successor. It also includes contractors, as preferred. It does not achieve the full preferred position because it adds neither perpetual and irrevocable treatment for paid-up licences nor the uncured-material-breach termination standard for subscription licences. The redline is not minimal and alters unrelated commercial intent because the successor carve-out applies reciprocally, giving TrueLink a new right to assign without consent; it should be limited to Client to address licence transferability. Otherwise, the additions are generally clear and professionally drafted.
